description: This Java class defines a MongoMetricsReporter that extends an abstract health-checking actor. It subscribes to a specific pub/sub topic to report and monitor metrics related to MongoDB timer performance, capturing data periodically and maintaining a historical record.

classes.name: MongoMetricsReporter
classes.description: A final class that reports on MongoDB metrics by subscribing to a pub/sub topic, collecting timing data, and providing health status updates.

classes.name: Tick
classes.description: A private static nested class representing a simple timer trigger used internally within MongoMetricsReporter.

methods.name: props
methods.description: A static factory method to create Props for initializing MongoMetricsReporter actors with specified resolution, history size, and mediator.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Defines how to handle custom messages like TICK and subscription acknowledgment within the actor's receive function.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Overrides a method to trigger health status collection and update.

methods.name: renderStatusInfo
methods.description: Constructs a StatusInfo object representing the current health status as UP with detailed metrics.

methods.name: renderStatusDetailMessage
methods.description: Creates a detailed status message encapsulating the current metrics in JSON format.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves current metrics data wrapped in a MongoMetrics object.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Handles the periodic timer trigger, updating the metrics with the latest maximum timer nanoseconds value.

methods.name: subscribeForTopicWithoutGroup
methods.description: Subscribes this actor to the pub/sub topic using the mediator.

methods.name: subscribeAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of subscription, logs confirmation.
